messages:
sam: heads up, ap-south1-b showing slow drift of pending GPUs. several tiny 0.25/0.5 inference pods scattered and two 8GPU experiments blocked

leah: is this the usual warmpool/taint dance or a scoring regression?

sam: scheduler traces show a combination: 1) strong topologySpread constraints for zone balance, 2) family-anchor hysteresis (we bias against moving a family's last pod for 45m), and 3) an increased fractional-pack penalty from rollout r2026-03-packing. together they produce spray placement leaving contiguous nodes unused

omar: can you paste a pending pod and a node summary?

sam: pending pod:
```
Name: inflight-021
requests.nvidia.com/gpu: 0.5
annotations: redwood/scheduler-hint=prefer-local-net
Status: Pending (0/64 nodes fit: Insufficient contiguous gpus)
```

node snapshot (sanitized):
```
node-a: 8 free contiguous (anchor=family-old, last_used=1h20m)
node-b: many 0.5s scattered across hosts
node-c: 4 free contiguous
node-d: 0 free
```

infra-bot: [alert] fragmentation_metric: high_unusable_slots ap-south1-b unusable_gpus=40 anomaly_score=0.72 triggered=1769777802

leah: action plan: 1) reduce family-anchor hysteresis for non-critical families from 45m->8m, 2) run a conservative coalescer for fractional pods only, 3) add a rollout guard for fractional-pack penalty so future rollouts must show fragmentation diffs

omar: agree. also add a safety rule on coalescer: do not evict pods younger than 4m and keep per-node eviction <= 12% to avoid thundering preempts

sam: dry-run: `infractl coalesce --region ap-south1-b --filter "requests.gpu<=0.5" --strategy pack-same-label --dry-run`

(small pause)

sam: dry-run result: would move ~16 small pods, free 2 contiguous 8-GPU slots, allow two blocked 8GPU jobs to schedule. recommended safe limits applied

oncall: approve conservative execute, but lower prefer-local-net hint weight to 0.35 first so we don't lose too much locality after coalesce

leah: rolling hint weight change now via feature-flag (ff-2026-hint-weight). applying to ap-south1-b canary.

infra-bot: [note] coalesce_job queued (id cj-2099) by sam at 1769777835

(90s later)

sam: executed conservative coalesce: moved 12 small pods, freed 2x8 contiguous slots. two 8GPU experiments scheduled, pending reduced by ~30%. no OOMs or surprise preempts observed

omar: created INFRA-9123: "hysteresis+packing causes fractional spray". items: add fragmentation checks to rollout pipelines, add anchor TTL guardrails, default hysteresis 8m for non-critical families, and coalescer safety defaults. assigning to eng-scheduler

leah: follow-ups: 1) add unit/integration test simulating topologySpread + family anchors + fractional requests, 2) surface fragmentation delta in canary dashboards, 3) schedule a nightly gentle-defrag pass when unusable_gpus>2% for >30m

oncall: noted. will adjust alerts to include estimated GPU-minutes stranded and ticket INFRA-9123 link

sam: cluster stabilized, two big jobs started. closing thread unless we see a spike. :white_check_mark:
